directAnswer: To reset a passkey, navigate to your account security settings and select the option to manage or reset passkeys. Follow the prompts to complete the reset process.
summary: Resetting a passkey involves accessing your account settings and following the necessary steps to update your security credentials.

sections.heading: Understanding Passkeys
sections.body: Passkeys are a secure alternative to passwords, designed to enhance account security by using cryptographic keys.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: The steps to reset a passkey may vary by platform. Below are the general steps for common platforms.

steps.title: For iOS Devices
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Passwords > Select the account > Tap 'Reset Passkey'.

steps.title: For Android Devices
steps.detail: Open Settings > Security > Passwords > Locate your account > Tap 'Reset Passkey'.

steps.title: For Web Accounts
steps.detail: Log into your account, navigate to Security Settings, and select 'Manage Passkeys' to reset.

faqs.question: What happens if I forget my passkey?
faqs.answer: If you forget your passkey, you will need to follow the account recovery process provided by your platform.

faqs.question: Can I have multiple passkeys for one account?
faqs.answer: Most platforms allow you to manage multiple passkeys, but this varies by service.

faqs.question: Is resetting a passkey secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as you follow the official procedures set by your platform, resetting a passkey is secure.

caveats: Ensure you have access to the recovery methods associated with your account before resetting.
The steps may vary slightly depending on the version of the operating system or application.
